title: The Ring of Mushrooms
text: A perfect ring of white mushrooms in a clearing, pale as knucklebones, and music from nowhere, sweet and thin. Step in, the stories say, and you dance for a night or a hundred years. In the middle of the ring lies a single shoe.

options.label: The boldest steps into the ring, and dances to the music from nowhere.

outcomes.text: They dance for a night, and come out laughing, and younger in the eyes.
They dance for longer than a night, and sleep where they fall.

options.label: The Leader picks the white mushrooms, music or no music.

outcomes.text: The music stops, all at once. The mushrooms are worth a great deal to the right apothecary.

options.label: Walk well round the ring, and do not listen too closely.

outcomes.text: The music follows you a while, and your feet keep wanting to dance. You are quicker on them for it.

options.label: The Gambler bets they can step in and out before the music notices.

outcomes.text: In and out, with a fistful of fair-folk coin and a grin.
In, and the music notices. They come out next morning, still dancing, a year older in the face.
